analyst.summary: RCF is a government-owned fertilizer maker whose profits are driven mainly by subsidy timing and input-cost pass-through rather than genuine business momentum -- revenue actually fell 23% in the most recent reported quarter even as profit rose off a very low base. The company has also disclosed a new regulatory cost hit of roughly Rs 172 crore from revised energy-efficiency rules at one of its plants. With weak interest coverage and no clear growth catalyst, we see no reason to hold rather than trim.
